ops.ci.bankNote: Bank details come from the partner questionnaire (Bank section). The intermediary bank is shown only when filled in.
ops.ci.closed: The invoice is paid; the cycle is complete.
ops.ci.draftNote: This is a draft. The invoice is sent to OTA when you press “Submit”.
ops.ci.fileH: The demo stores the file name only.
ops.ci.intro: Commission per statement: {a}. Submit your invoice by {d}: the portal proposes a draft on template 14, or upload your own invoice.
ops.ci.none: No commission is payable for this month — no invoice is needed.
ops.ci.overdue: The deadline to submit the invoice ({d}) has passed. Please submit it as soon as possible.
ops.ci.propP: The amount comes from statement {rs}. Numbering is your own; the portal stores the link to the statement.
ops.ci.propose: Propose a draft from the statement
ops.ci.rc: UAE VAT accounted by reverse charge
ops.ci.upP: The invoice must carry the same information as template 14. Amount before VAT: {a}.
ops.ci.vatH: As concluded by the partner’s tax adviser.
ops.ci.wait: The invoice becomes available once the reconciliation statement is confirmed.
ops.disp.done: Dispute on statement {n} sent to OTA
ops.disp.err: Write a comment (a few words at least)
ops.disp.hint: Explain what does not match your records.
ops.docs.how: Documents are built from the legal templates (English | Russian) as A4 pages. “Print / PDF” opens the print view.
ops.docs.sub: All invoices, credit notes, reconciliation statements, partner invoices and SIM documents in one place.
ops.docs.title: Documents → Operations
ops.inv.vat0: Partner outside the UAE ({cc}): VAT 0% — zero-rated export of services, with the legal basis (Article 31, Executive Regulation of Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017). Keys and tokens are issued only after the payment mark.
ops.inv.vat5.h: Attention, OTA Finance: the partner is registered in the UAE — VAT 5% applied.
ops.inv.vat5.p: Template 13 has no wording for 5%, so the document shows [wording to be approved]. Confirm the text with the accountant.
ops.iss.p: Issued only after OTA Finance marks the invoice as paid.
ops.iss.t: Keys and tokens of the month
ops.ln.retained: Less OTA Retained Amount (× paid months)
ops.ln.tax: Less OTA taxes in the customer’s country
ops.missing: The template has no values for: {k}
ops.nf.p: It may have been removed or the link is out of date.
ops.rs.aNote: Gross payments are in USD at the acquirer’s rate. The statement is not a tax invoice and does not set off any payment.
ops.rs.adm.p: OTA Finance generates the statements for {m} (automatically by the 10th) and closes disputes.
ops.rs.b.autoP: No answer from the partner within the period.
ops.rs.b.disputedP: Undisputed amounts are paid on time. OTA answers the dispute, then the statement is confirmed.
ops.rs.b.issued: This statement awaits your answer until {d}.
ops.rs.b.issuedP: Confirm it or dispute individual lines. If you stay silent it is deemed confirmed.
ops.rs.emptyP: The first statement appears after a month with direct-subscription payments closes.
ops.rs.genNone: All statements for {m} are already generated
ops.rs.how: Confirm the statement or dispute individual lines within 5 business days. No answer means it is confirmed automatically. After confirmation the portal proposes a draft commission invoice (due by the 15th).
ops.rs.secB: B. OTA invoices of the month
ops.rs.sub: Every month by the 10th for the previous month, per country.
ops.rs.title: Reconciliation statements
ops.sim5.h: Demo: moves the clock by 5 business days and auto-confirms statements the partner did not answer.
ops.sr.blank: The partner has not confirmed receipt yet: quantity, condition and storage fields are left blank to be completed by hand.
ord.cancelAlso: This invoice also covers: {n} — they will be cancelled too.
ord.cancelP: Invoice {i} has been issued, so it is not deleted but cancelled by credit note {cn}. The invoice number is never reused.
ord.cn.askOpen: Credit note {cn} for {a} will be issued. The invoice becomes “Cancelled”.
ord.cn.askPaid: The invoice is paid. Credit note {cn} for {a} revokes the issued keys and tokens (still unused); the refund is handled separately.
ord.cn.fail: Can’t cancel: keys or tokens from this invoice are already in use
ord.cn.noteOpen: The invoice was not paid — nothing is due.
ord.cn.notePaid: Keys and tokens from the cancelled invoice are revoked. The refund goes to the partner’s bank account.
ord.cn.title: Credit notes
ord.cnReason.partner: Order cancelled by the partner before payment
ord.d.noInv: The invoice is issued when you confirm the draft.
ord.del.draftP: No invoice has been issued yet, so the draft can be deleted.
ord.doc.banner.issue: Keys and tokens appear on your balance right after payment.
ord.doc.banner.xchg: Once paid, the token exchange completes automatically.
ord.doc.issuedNote: Keys and tokens have been issued.
ord.doc.markPaidNote: Confirm the money has reached OTA’s account — keys and tokens are issued automatically.
ord.doc.reported: You reported the payment — waiting for it to arrive
ord.doc.reportedToast: Thanks! We’ll issue the keys and tokens as soon as the money arrives.
ord.doc.simNote: SIM cards shipped under the Agreement are provided free of separate charge, remain the property of OTA or its supplier and are not invoiced.
ord.doc.terms: Payment terms: 100% prepayment by bank transfer in USD; keys and tokens are issued after payment. The payer’s bank charges are borne by the payer. Please quote the invoice number.
ord.doc.vatWarn: Partner is registered in the UAE: 5% instead of 0% export. Check with Finance.
ord.empty.p: Start with Activation Keys — one per device — and Service Tokens for packages.
ord.f.cc.d: Prices come from the country price list (Order Form of that country).
ord.f.keys.d: A licence key for the CONNECT program. One key per device, for life. It is used when a device is activated for the first time.
ord.f.keys.errMin: At least {n} keys (or 0 if you don’t need keys).
ord.f.keys.sim: Keys are not tied to SIM shipments: OTA ships SIM cards separately, in custody.
ord.f.mode.combined.d: Keys and tokens on one invoice.
ord.f.mode.separate.d: One for keys, one for tokens.
ord.f.mode.single: There’s only one kind of item now — you’ll get one invoice.
ord.f.tok.d: A token is a prepaid connectivity package (plan × term). Valid for 36 months from issue; each activation uses one token of the exact plan and term.
ord.f.tok.locked: You can buy tokens once OTA assigns a plan to at least one of your models.
ord.howItWorks: A device needs one Activation Key for life and one Service Token per package. Both are issued automatically once OTA receives the payment. SIM cards are not sold: OTA ships them to you in custody, free of charge (see “SIM shipments”).
ord.inv.empty.p: An invoice appears as soon as you place an order.
ord.inv.sub: Tax Invoices from OTA TECHNOLOGY DMCC in US dollars, and credit notes.
ord.inv.title: Invoices
ord.new.sub: Keys and tokens can be ordered together — on one invoice or two.
ord.noPl.p: OTA has not set prices for this country yet.
ord.noPl.t: No price list for this country
ord.notfound.p: The link may be out of date.
